mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_uid AS orderUid, o.user_id AS userId, o.acorn_amount AS acornAmount, o.price AS price, o.status AS orderStatus, o.created_at AS createdAt, p.pg_tx_id AS pgTxId, p.method AS method, p.amount AS paymentAmount, p.status AS paymentStatus, p.pg_status AS pgStatus, p.failure_code AS failureCode, p.paid_at AS paidAt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_uid = #{orderUid}

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM acorn_transaction WHERE reason = 'CHARGE'), 0) AS totalChargedAcorn, COALESCE((SELECT -SUM(amount) FROM acorn_transaction WHERE reason = 'REFUND'), 0) AS totalRefundedAcorn, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(price) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID'), 0) AS totalSalesAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID') AS paidCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELING') AS cancelingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELED') AS canceledCount
